name: Jake Curran
bio: Jake Curran is a British actor whose career spans from 1978 to the present with over 50 credited roles. His date and place of birth are unconfirmed. His film credits include Stardust (2007), Robin Hood (2010), Fury (2014), Maze Runner: The Death Cure (2018), and Clayface (2026, post-production). On television he has appeared in Gangs of London (2022), The Salisbury Poisonings (2020), and Robin Hood (2025), and is currently filming as Ronan the Centaur in Harry Potter (2027). In theatre he appeared in The Play That Goes Wrong (West End, 2021). No major awards are on record.
